title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00076 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 00:30: Continued POOH to surface
00:30 - 02:30: L/d BHA. Experienced over-torqued connection. Needed to clean jaws on IRN and break connections with 160 KNM. Cleaned and cleared drill floor
02:30 - 02:45: Performed TBT for m/u and RIH with cutter BHA
02:45 - 03:45: P/u and m/u cutter BHA. P/u and m/u 1 STD 5 1/2" DP.
03:45 - 04:00: Installed PS-21 slips in rotary table.
04:00 - 05:45: RIH w/ cutter BHA on 5 1/2" DP from 17 m to 701 m Avg. Tripping speed 390 m/hr.
05:45 - 06:00: Pulled out PS-21 slips and installed masterbushing
06:00 - 06:15: Performed TBT for p/u and m/u spear assy
06:15 - 07:00: P/u spear assy from derrick and stroke out bumper sub. B/o bullnose at bottom.
07:00 - 09:00: Installed XO and m/u spear assy
09:00 - 09:30: RIH w/ cutter BHA on 5 1/2" DP from 711 m to 817 m Avg. Tripping speed 230 m/hr.
09:30 - 10:30: Filled pipe. M/u TDS and recorded up/down weight 100/95 ton. Continued RIH to cutting depth at 853 mmd. Engaged spear. Initiated circulation 1675 LPM 78 bar and cut 10 3/4" x 9 5/8" casing at 850 mmd. Lost 40 ton weight. Up weight with fish 155 ton. Released spear.
10:30 - 11:00: POOH w/ cutter BHA on 5 1/2" DP from 853 m to 748 m.
11:00 - 12:45: Observed 0,4 m3 gain in trip tank. Spaced out and closed annular preventer. Monitored choke pressure for pressure build up no pressure build up observed. Circulated over choke 200 LPM for 30 min. Monitored choke for pressure build up. Opened BOP and flowcheck 15 min slight gain in trip tank.
12:45 - 13:00: Function tested BOP
13:00 - 13:30: Investigated slight gain in trip tank. Found fresh water leaking into flowline.
13:30 - 14:45: Continued POOH w/ cutter BHA on 5 1/2" DP from 760 m to 706 m. Inspected spear assy and r/b same. L/o XO.
14:45 - 15:00: Removed master bushing and installed PS-21 slips
15:00 - 16:00: POOH w/ cutter BHA on 5 1/2" DP from 706 m to 17 m Avg. Tripping speed 680 m/hr.
16:00 - 16:15: Removed PS-21 slips and installed master bushing
16:15 - 16:45
